section_summary.extract_value: This section presents convergent validity analyses examining correlations between breast size dissatisfaction and multiple variables including BMI, body appreciation, body satisfaction, and appearance-related pressures and ideals. The analyses were conducted on the total sample as well as separately for women who desired larger breasts (reported in supplementary materials), with findings showing significant associations between greater breast size dissatisfaction and higher BMI, lower body appreciation, and greater internalization of appearance ideals.
section_summary.evidence_source: Section 5.2 titled 'Convergent validity' describing bivariate correlation analyses and their results.
